description: Percentage of the time window during which feeding was blocked due to attribute resource usage limits on any content node.
Maximum number of buckets pending a move operation (e.g. during cluster resizing or redistribution) on any content node.
Cache hit rate for the ready document store's summary-field cache, as a percentage; low values on quiescent clusters often show up as elevated CPU IOWait from disk-backed docsum reads.
Maximum disk space used by the ready document store on any content node.
Number of active/searchable document copies, summed across content clusters after taking the max across replica groups within each cluster to avoid double counting.
Maximum observed saturation of Proton's field writer executor thread pool; high saturation indicates a write bottleneck.
Average utilization of Proton's field writer executor thread pool across content nodes.
Average time operations spent waiting in the filestor queue across content nodes.
Maximum filestor queue size observed on any content node; a growing queue indicates storage cannot keep up with incoming operations.
Activity level of the attribute-flush maintenance job (0% = idle, 100% = fully active), maximum across content nodes.
Relative disk usage of the content node's Proton process, as a percentage of the available disk; 100% means feeding is blocked.
Average utilization of Proton's own executor thread pool across content nodes.
Relative memory usage of the content node's Proton process, as a percentage of the available memory.
Maximum shared executor queue size observed on any content node during the time window.
Average utilization of Proton's shared executor thread pool across content nodes.
